title: Christmas movie fondue (brown Meltie mug, city apartment) — restage 09
notes: Restage 09 of shorts/Su66AMPolD0 ("you + me?"): BROWN variant of the real Meltie Mini Fondue Mug (store photos), the treats on the smoked-glass coffee table (a smoked-glass coffee table in a modern apartment at night, a floor-to-ceiling window with blurred city lights behind, a grey bouclé armchair at the side) instead of the white desk in front of a red curtain and a Christmas tree. Table decor kept (gnome pumpkin, pumpkins, candle jar, laptop). Reworded hook. The pour and the last dip spill on purpose (brief). Laptop: generated fictional holiday-film stills (no children, no real film footage); plain unbranded red bag; Sora audio.
